basis: Official product photographs visually reviewed in v13 and source body re-read in v14. Visual evidence in docs/research/image-briefs-v13.json and v14 product-depth-second research. Images are not copied into the public site.
scope: Editorial descriptions only. Product prices, material masters, sources, purchase evidence, availability and verification dates are unchanged.

changes.before: ToyToy’s wooden earrings leave open space within the pattern. We chose this contemporary design for someone who wants a silhouette shaped by lines and gaps.
changes.after: ToyToy’s Nikuri earrings set pale carved lines against a dark wooden face. We picked them for the contrast between the patterned surface and the shaped outline.

changes.before: 文様のあいだに空間がある、ToyToyの木のピアス。面を埋める模様より、線がつくるシルエットを楽しみたい人へ選ぶ現代のデザインです。
changes.after: 濃い木の面に淡い彫りの線が浮かぶ、ToyToyのニクリ。文様のある表面と外側の輪郭、その両方を選ぶ木のピアスです。

before: A wooden pattern with an open outline

before.title: A wooden silhouette beside a dark collar
before.body: Try a dark neckline and leave the ear area clear of a scarf or covering hair. The spaces within the pattern deserve as much room as the wooden lines.

after.title: A carved wooden face beside a plain collar
after.body: Try a plain dark neckline as a background for the patterned wooden surface. Leave the ear area clear of a scarf or covering hair so the shaped edge is visible.

changes.before: 木の文様を、輪郭と余白で。
changes.after: 木の表情に、彫りの線を。

after: 木の面に刻まれた文様の線

before.title: 濃色の襟元に、木のシルエット
before.body: 濃い色の襟元へ、木の文様が見える組み合わせを考える提案。髪やスカーフで輪郭を隠さず、線のあいだの余白も見せてみてください。

after.title: 無地の襟元に、木の彫り模様
after.body: 濃色の無地を背景に、木の面と淡い文様の違いを見せる提案。髪やスカーフを少しよけると、外側の輪郭も合わせて楽しめます。

changes.before: The open pattern is a contemporary design by the specific ToyToy brand, whose designer identifies as Hokkaido Ainu. It is not presented as a universal design shared by all Ainu communities.
changes.after: The carved wooden face is a contemporary design by ToyToy, whose designer identifies as Hokkaido Ainu. Read the maker’s explanation as the context for this particular design.

changes.before: ToyToy’s Sirokani-pe puts its pattern within a compact drop-shaped pendant. We chose it for someone who wants silver color and curves rather than another colored stone.
changes.after: ToyToy’s Sirokani-pe brings an open, curving silver motif to a compact pendant. We picked it for someone who wants a small metal pattern rather than a colored stone.

changes.before: コンパクトなしずく形に文様を載せた、ToyToyのシロカニペ。色石を足すかわりに、銀の色と曲線を首元へ選びたい人に。
changes.after: 小さな銀の曲線が文様をつくる、ToyToyのシロカニペ。色石を足すかわりに、抜けのある金属の形を首元へ選びたい人に。

changes.before: This is silver rather than the same brand’s cut-out wood. A drop-shaped top carries the design in a compact, solid outline.
changes.after: An open motif of silver curves, unlike the carved surface of the same brand’s wooden earrings. Compare the metal outline with Nikuri’s wooden face.

changes.before: 同ブランドの透かしのある木工とは違う、銀の一品。しずく形のトップに、コンパクトな輪郭で文様を載せています。
changes.after: 同ブランドの木の彫り面に対し、こちらは銀の曲線のあいだに空間がある文様。ニクリの木の表面と、金属の輪郭を見比べて選べます。

changes.before: The motif has a long outline. For a compact metal flower compare CHECOS; for open pattern in wood compare ToyToy.
changes.after: The motif has a long outline. For a compact metal flower compare CHECOS; for a carved pattern on a wooden face compare ToyToy.

changes.before: 縦に長さのある花菱です。小さくまとまる金属の花を探すならCHECOS、木の抜けた文様ならToyToyも候補です。
changes.after: 縦に長さのある花菱です。小さくまとまる金属の花を探すならCHECOS、木の面の彫り模様ならToyToyも候補です。

changes.before: A repeating Shippo pattern forms this broad brass bangle. We chose it for someone who wants a metal motif and is interested in how uncoated brass changes with use.
changes.after: Engraved interlocking circles run across this broad brass bangle. We chose it for someone who wants a patterned metal surface and welcomes the changing color of uncoated brass.

changes.before: 七宝文様の円が繰り返す、幅のある真鍮バングル。金属の色の変化も含めて、ひとつの文様を使っていきたい人へ選びました。
changes.after: 真鍮の面に七宝文様の円を彫った、幅のあるバングル。ひとつの文様と、無塗装の金属の色の変化を楽しみたい人へ選びました。

changes.after: Engraved interlocking circles run across this broad brass bangle. We chose it for someone who wants a patterned metal surface and welcomes the changing color of uncoated brass.

changes.before: 七宝文様の円が繰り返す、幅のある真鍮バングル。金属の色の変化も含めて、ひとつの文様を使っていきたい人へ選びました。
changes.after: 真鍮の面に七宝文様の円を彫った、幅のあるバングル。ひとつの文様と、無塗装の金属の色の変化を楽しみたい人へ選びました。

changes.before: Shippo names the interlocking-circle pattern here; this is uncoated brass decorative metalwork, not fired cloisonné enamel.
changes.after: Shippo names the engraved interlocking-circle pattern on the brass surface. It is uncoated decorative metalwork, with neither cut-out holes nor fired cloisonné color.

changes.before: ここでの七宝は円を重ねた文様の名前。塗装のない真鍮の錺金具技法で、七宝焼の釉薬仕上げではありません。
changes.after: 真鍮の面に円を重ねて彫った七宝文様。穴をあけた透かしや、七宝焼の釉薬による色の仕上げではありません。
